draft.heroMessage: Local expertise. Dedicated service. Real answers.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Ryan Realty—with Matt Ryan, Principal Broker and owner, leading the way in Bend and Central Oregon real estate.
draft.tagline: Guiding you home in Central Oregon.
draft.aboutParagraph: As owner and principal broker of Ryan Realty, Matt Ryan believes buying or selling a home should always be grounded in honest advice and deep local knowledge. Our boutique firm is built on direct relationships, hands-on guidance, and plainspoken answers from the start of your search through closing. Whether you're comparing neighborhoods in Bend or making your first investment in Central Oregon, you'll always work closely with an experienced broker who lives here. Every recommendation—each property search, valuation, or listing—reflects years of market insight and a genuine commitment to your goals.
draft.conciergeLine: For a candid conversation about your options in Bend, call or text Matt directly at 541.703.3095.
draft.contactLine: Ready to take the next step in Central Oregon real estate? Reach Matt Ryan at matt@ryan-realty.com or 541.703.3095.
draft.tone: warm, transparent, and detail-oriented with an emphasis on direct client/broker relationships and local expertise.

sections.title: The team behind Ryan Realty
sections.body: How it started Matt Ryan, owner and principal broker, started Ryan Realty LLC in 2014 and opened the Bend office in June 2023, after years in the fire service. He learned the business from his mentor, Hjalmar "Red" Erickson, and runs the brokerage the way Red taught him: every client gets the same care and the same effort. The brokers Ryan Realty has three licensed brokers, and all three live and work in Central Oregon. Each broker's page has their Oregon license, recorded closings, and direct line.

sections.title: What different budgets tend to buy
sections.body: We do not print price bands here because they move every month. The pattern holds, though. At the entry level in Bend the choices are condos and townhomes, older homes on the east side, and smaller homes in the districts farther from downtown. The same money in Redmond buys a newer single-family home with a yard. Farther out, La Pine and Prineville buy more house again with a longer drive. The Bend and Redmond market pages show the current medians, and Bend vs Redmond vs Sisters covers the trade in each direction.

sections.title: What you are really choosing
sections.body: You are choosing between three things: how much house your money buys, how close you are to the things that made you look at Central Oregon, and how much town you want around you. Bend has the most of everything and costs the most. Redmond has the airport, a working downtown, and more house per dollar. Sisters is small, walkable, and quiet, with the Cascades right there. The live prices for each are on the market pages linked in each section.

sections.title: Loan program fees
sections.body: FHA. The upfront mortgage insurance premium is 1.75% of the base loan amount, and it can be financed into the loan. The annual premium on a 30-year loan with less than 5% down and a loan amount at or under the FHA base limit is 0.55% of the loan per year, collected monthly, per HUD's current mortgagee letter. VA. The funding fee for a purchase is 2.15% of the loan on first use with less than 5% down, 3.3% on later use, 1.5% with 5% or more down, and 1.25% with 10% or more down.
